name: QuickCut
author: ncSender
description: G-code generator for common CNC ops: rectangles + circles (perimeter/clearing/outer, with Linear (any angle) or Circular patterns), Planer (target-depth/thickness/wasteboard-surfacing), Jointer (straight reference edge), Cutter (cold-saw parting cut to exact dimension), Keyhole (hanging slots with a keyhole bit), Drill (holes with optional pecking), holding tabs on profile cuts, and Angle (measure the angle from the origin to a typed or grabbed point, for patterns). Metric + imperial, honors core safeZHeight.
